thread:
rowan: Quick prelaunch pulse for tomorrow's webinar + launch posts. We need: final KW targets, JSON-LD (Event + 1 FAQ), internal linking map, and a redirect plan. Owners by EOD?

neha: I can own keyword finalization and anchors. Will prune to top 8 intent-based kws and add anchor text suggestions.

lars: I'll take redirects. Important: preserve UTMs and canonical behavior for /resources/webinar which currently points to blog. Will propose rules and a canary.

taylor: I'll handle the schema + FAQ snippet and validate injection in the landing branch. Keep FAQ to a single, search-friendly Q.

seo-bot: site-scan: 4 pages with missing Event structured data, 5 duplicate meta descriptions. Report: https://tiny.example/scan3923

rowan: Neha, paste the KW sheet link and include funnel intent column. Lars, paste the nginx examples when ready. Taylor, paste JSON-LD here so we can sanity-check.

neha: KW sheet: https://tiny.example/kw-final (cols: kw, intent, priority, anchor). Top kws: "inference latency", "LLM serving at scale", "inference cost optimization".

lars: Redirect rules (nginx examples):
```nginx
# keep qs
rewrite ^/blog/2026/([^/]+)-webinar$ /webinars/inference-production-2026?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=inference_launch permanent;
location = /resources/webinar { return 301 /webinars/inference-production-2026; }
```

taylor: JSON-LD draft to drop on landing (Event + one FAQ):
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"WebPage","mainEntity":{"@type":"Event","name":"Inference in Production","startDate":"2026-03-26T17:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.example/webinars/inference-production-2026","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.example/webinars/inference-production-2026"}},"@graph":[{"@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"Who should attend?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Platform and ML engineers building production inference."}}]}]}
```

rowan: Nice. Linking plan: 3 contextual links from pillar article -> landing (anchors: "inference latency", "cost per token", "serving patterns") + 1 link from product docs. Use UTMs: ?utm_source=article&utm_medium=internal_link&utm_campaign=inference_launch.

neha: Added anchor suggestions in the sheet and short anchor copy variations for A/B testing.

lars: I'll open the redirects PR with smoke tests (curl checks, rel=canonical verification) and ask eng-infra for a reload window. Canary first, full rollout after QA.

taylor: I'll add unit tests to verify JSON-LD present and FAQ structured data validates. Also adding meta description suggestion for the landing (~150 chars).

rowan: Timeline recap: redirects PR + smoke tests by 15:00, schema + tests by 16:00, KW + anchors locked by 17:00, messaging locked by 18:00, final QA 20:00 PT. Go-live tomorrow 09:00 PT. Any blockers?

seo-bot: recommendation: set rel=\"canonical\" on old pages to the new landing after redirect, and limit FAQ to one question to reduce markup noise.

neha: no blockers.

lars: none, will flag if reload window conflicts.

taylor: all good.

rowan: Great work team 680. Post updates here if anything shifts.
